描述_EN: many mirrors are decorated with mystical scenes of daoism. this mirror shows xiwangmu and dongwangfu, queen mother of the west and king father of the east, the most popular scene to be found on mirrors of the han dynasty (206bc-ad220). mirrors in china were associated with daoist mysticism as well as being a functional object in the house.
描述_ZN: 许多镜子上都装饰着道教的神秘场景。 这面镜子展示了西王母和东王母，即西王母和东王父，这是汉代（公元前206年-公元220年）镜子上最流行的场景。 中国的镜子与道家的神秘主义有关，同时也是家里的一个实用物品。
